description: Build a Skimless review packet: which files to read first, which can wait, and the rule behind every flag. Pass a unified diff, or omit it to run git diff in the repository. Secret-shaped strings are always redacted. No network, no model.

base.description: Compare base...HEAD, the way a pull request does. Example: origin/main.

budgetMinutes.description: Flag a packet that takes longer than this to read.

cwd.description: Repository directory. Defaults to the directory the server started in.

diff.description: A unified diff. If omitted, Skimless runs git diff in the repository.

format.description: summary (Markdown, default) or json (full packet without diff lines).

lang.description: Packet language. Default: en, or skimless.config.json.

name: review_diff
title: Reading order for a diff
